_about: Mochiioteca achievement layer (List 8 #69). Achievements are PREDICATES over #14's derived completion state + #12 flags — evaluated at read time, never stored, and they grant nothing (#14's ladder grants; this layer records). The achievement LIST is OPEN owner content; this fragment fixes the record shape, the closed predicate vocabulary, and the tier kinds.
predicate_vocabulary_closed: count_ge(derived, threshold) — derived in {seenCount, keptCount, regionSeenCount(region), regionKeptCount(region)}
event(name) — name in {first_seen, first_kept, region_seen_complete, region_kept_complete}

record_shape.predicate: one expression from the closed vocabulary
record_shape.title: OPEN — owner names records

tiers.device: the #14 upgrade milestone's record page (one event, one flag write, one derived record)
tiers.note: a line in the Mochiioteca record
tiers.page: a full record page — #14's certificate kind
